name: driveway
title: DriveWay
description: Discover, mount, and unmount SMB and WebDAV network drives. Save multiple servers with aliases and reconnect or mount them all at once. (The Domain/IP preference is for one always-included host, not where you add multiple servers.)
author: pankajpopli

commands.name: index
commands.title: Manage Drives
commands.description: View, edit, remove, connect, and disconnect your saved drives. If Domain/IP is set in Preferences, also browse that server's shares live.

commands.name: add-server
commands.title: Add Drive
commands.description: Save a new drive (host, share path, optional alias and username) to your list.

commands.name: scan-network
commands.title: Discover Devices
commands.description: Finds SMB and WebDAV servers, computers, and other devices on your local network via Bonjour/mDNS, a subnet scan, and a ping sweep, per the Network Discovery preferences below.

commands.name: mount-shares
commands.title: Mount All
commands.description: Mount every saved, reachable drive at once.

commands.name: unmount-shares
commands.title: Unmount All
commands.description: Unmount every currently connected saved drive at once.

commands.name: auto-reconnect
commands.title: Auto-Reconnect
commands.description: Runs in the background and silently reconnects saved drives with Auto-Reconnect enabled. Never touches drives without it, and never unmounts anything. Actual cadence is controlled by the Interval preference below.

preferences.name: pref_auto_reconnect_interval
preferences.title: Interval
preferences.description: How often to retry drives with Auto-Reconnect enabled. This command checks every 5 minutes, but only does anything once this much time has actually passed. To turn the command off entirely, use the Background Refresh toggle above instead. This only sets cadence.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: DriveWay Menu Bar
commands.description: Shows saved drives in the menu bar with live connection status and one-click mount/unmount.

preferences.name: pref_menu_bar_refresh_interval
preferences.title: Refresh Interval
preferences.description: How often status re-checks itself in the background. Opening the menu always shows the last-known status instantly, then refreshes for real only once this much time has passed. To stop background refresh entirely (rely on the menu's own Refresh item only), use the Background Refresh toggle above instead. This only sets cadence.

preferences.name: pref_discovery_bonjour
preferences.title: Network Discovery
preferences.label: Bonjour/mDNS discovery
preferences.description: Finds self-advertising SMB/WebDAV servers. Fast, passive. See README for details.

preferences.name: pref_discovery_subnet_scan
preferences.label: Scan local subnet
preferences.description: Probes for open SMB/WebDAV ports. Slower, active scan. See README for details.

preferences.name: pref_discovery_all_devices
preferences.label: Show all network devices
preferences.description: Pings everything, any protocol. Broadest, noisiest option. See README for details.

preferences.name: pref_discovery_host
preferences.title: Domain / IP
preferences.description: Always include this one host (optional). For multiple servers, use Add Drive instead.
